_doc: Prompts for this channel's music library (Drive Music-Library/forensic/). Generate with scripts/lyria_music.py; PLAYBOOK §12.1.
common: Instrumental only: no vocals, no choir, no humming, no spoken words, no vocal samples, and no pads or synths that sound like voices or a choir: sustained sounds come from bowed strings, piano, electric piano, organ-free analogue synths and electronic hum. This is a documentary underscore that plays under a narrator's voice: no lead melody in the speech range, no sudden loud hits or long silences, a steady overall level from start to finish, clean cinematic mix, wide stereo. Make it about three minutes long. It ends with a final held chord or note that decays naturally, never an abrupt cut.

tracks.title: The Incident
tracks.use: Act I, the incident in media res on the record
tracks.prompt: Cold and tense, in media res. 72 BPM, D minor. A low analogue synth bass drone, a slow soft kick-like pulse every bar, a quiet ticking like an instrument panel clock, sparse single felt-piano notes, low cello held notes. Clinical and restrained, like reading timestamps on a flight record. No melody.
tracks.brief: cold tense sparse drone, faint pulse, single piano notes, no drums

tracks.title: The Mechanism
tracks.use: Act II, how the system was designed to work: schematics, redundancy
tracks.prompt: Clinical and neutral. 90 BPM, A minor. A soft, cool synth arpeggio, low warm pad, a quiet steady pulse, glassy textures. Feels like a clean engineering schematic: orderly, calm, slightly cold. No drums.
tracks.brief: clinical neutral cool synth arpeggio, orderly, no drums

tracks.title: The Boardroom
tracks.use: Act III, documents, filings and the decision that traded the margin
tracks.prompt: Quiet unease in a corporate setting. 78 BPM, F minor. Muted piano chords, low sustained strings, a soft ticking like a wall clock, a faint low-frequency hum. Restrained and subdued, the feeling of a decision being made in a quiet room. No drama, no villain music.
tracks.brief: quiet unease, muted piano, low strings, ticking, restrained, not villainous

tracks.title: The Cascade
tracks.use: Act IV, the physical consequence: the crack, the bearing, the bolt
tracks.prompt: Building dread, mechanical. 84 BPM, C minor. A low mechanical pulse, slow low brass and cello swells, metallic resonances, a sub drone that gradually grows. Builds slowly and steadily over the piece without becoming loud or chaotic; controlled and heavy.
tracks.brief: building dread, mechanical pulse, low swells, controlled, not chaotic

tracks.title: The Verdict
tracks.use: Act V, findings, litigation, regulation; the sign-off
tracks.prompt: Sober and reflective. 66 BPM, E minor. Single sparse felt-piano notes over low held cello and double bass, a faint electric hum underneath. Understated, calm and quiet, room to think. Ends on a single low held piano note.
tracks.brief: sober reflective sparse piano over low cello, understated

tracks.title: Room Tone Drone
tracks.use: The continuous low bed under quiet stretches; the 'silence' that is never silent
tracks.prompt: A near-static low bed. A very low analogue synth bass tone and a soft electrical hum like a server room, held double bass notes that change every twenty seconds, faint air-conditioning hiss. No rhythm, no melody, no piano. It should almost disappear under a voice. Constant and seamless.
tracks.brief: near-static low electronic hum and bass tones, no rhythm or melody, seamless

tracks.title: The Exhibit
tracks.use: Documents and records pulled up as exhibits; the highlighted line
tracks.prompt: Investigative and focused. 92 BPM, G minor. A soft repeating piano ostinato, a muted pulsing bass, light ticking percussion, a low pad. Steady forward motion, like an investigator going through a file page by page. Cold and attentive.
tracks.brief: investigative focused piano ostinato, muted bass, steady motion

tracks.title: Time to Failure
tracks.use: A timeline running down to the moment of failure
tracks.prompt: A countdown. 100 BPM, B minor. A precise ticking pulse, a low synth bass on each bar, a rising sustained string cluster that slowly climbs in pitch and intensity, held under control. Ends by settling to a low held drone.
tracks.brief: precise ticking countdown, slowly rising tension, controlled

tracks.title: Aftermath
tracks.use: After the failure: the wreckage, the silence, the people affected
tracks.prompt: Solemn and respectful. 58 BPM, A minor. Distant slow strings, a soft low pad, very sparse low piano. Empty and cold yet human and dignified, the quiet after something has ended. No percussion.
tracks.brief: solemn respectful empty, slow strings, no percussion

tracks.title: Sign-off
tracks.prompt: Understated closing. 70 BPM, D minor resolving to D major at the very end. A quiet low pulse, soft piano chords, a cool pad. Calm and final, ends on a soft held chord.
tracks.brief: understated calm closing, soft piano, final held chord

tracks.title: Shorts Bed
tracks.use: Vertical Shorts: a cold hook and one finding
tracks.prompt: Make this one about one minute long. Starts immediately with no intro: a cold low pulse, a tense sustained string harmonic and sparse piano notes, 86 BPM, E minor. Tension holds throughout, ends on a held low note.
tracks.brief: cold tense immediate start, about one minute
